```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
# Setup and data import
library(tidyverse)

DATA_FILE <- "fmr2027.csv"  # relative to this .qmd file
REF_BEDROOMS <- 2           # bedroom count for single-size views and ratios
N_EXTREME <- 12             # areas shown at each end of the extremes plot
JITTER_SEED <- 1            # deterministic jitter

```

```{r}
#| label: import
#| output: false
fmr_raw <- read_csv(
  DATA_FILE,
  col_types = cols(
    fips = col_character(), stusps = col_character(),
    state = col_character(), countyname = col_character(),
    county_town_name = col_character(), hud_area_code = col_character(),
    hud_area_name = col_character(), metro = col_integer(),
    pop2024 = col_double(), bedrooms = col_integer(), fmr = col_double()
  )
)

# fail loudly if the structure we rely on is not there
stopifnot(
  nrow(problems(fmr_raw)) == 0,
  all(fmr_raw$metro %in% c(0L, 1L)),
  REF_BEDROOMS %in% fmr_raw$bedrooms
)
```

```{r}
#| label: derive
#| output: false
# Records: one row per geographic record and bedroom count.
fmr <- fmr_raw |>
  mutate(
    metro = factor(metro, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("nonmetro", "metro")),
    # fips = state (2) + county (3) + county subdivision (5);
    # a 99999 subdivision code means the whole county
    record_type = if_else(str_ends(fips, "99999"), "county", "sub-county")
  )

# Areas: one row per HUD FMR area and bedroom count. FMR must be identical
# for every record in an area; population is summed over the records.
stopifnot(
  fmr |>
    summarise(k = n_distinct(fmr), .by = c(hud_area_code, bedrooms)) |>
    pull(k) |>
    (\(k) all(k == 1))()
)

areas <- fmr |>
  summarise(
    fmr = first(fmr),
    pop = sum(pop2024),
    n_records = n(),
    .by = c(hud_area_code, hud_area_name, metro, bedrooms)
  )

# An area that crosses a state line is kept once in each state it touches.
area_states <- fmr |>
  distinct(hud_area_code, stusps, metro, bedrooms, fmr)

bedroom_levels <- sort(unique(fmr$bedrooms))
records_ref <- filter(fmr, bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS)
areas_ref <- filter(areas, bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-1
#| fig-width: 7.1
#| fig-height: 8.4
state_counts <- fmr |>
  filter(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS) |>
  summarise(
    records = n(),
    `HUD areas` = n_distinct(hud_area_code),
    .by = stusps
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-stusps, names_to = "unit", values_to = "count") |>
  mutate(stusps = fct_reorder(stusps, count, .fun = max))

ggplot(state_counts, aes(count, stusps)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = stusps), colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = unit), size = 2) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300)) +
  labs(x = "count", y = "stusps", colour = "unit", caption = "Figure 1") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-2
#| fig-width: 7.1
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(areas, aes(fmr)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 100, boundary = 0) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(bedrooms), labeller = label_both) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "fmr ($)", y = "count (HUD areas)", caption = "Figure 2") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-3
#| fig-width: 7.1
#| fig-height: 4.2
bedroom_ratios <- areas |>
  select(hud_area_code, bedrooms, fmr) |>
  mutate(ratio = fmr / fmr[bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS], .by = hud_area_code) |>
  filter(bedrooms != REF_BEDROOMS)

ggplot(bedroom_ratios, aes(ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, boundary = 0) +
  facet_wrap(vars(bedrooms), scales = "free_x", labeller = label_both) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4)) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("fmr / fmr (", REF_BEDROOMS, " bedrooms)"),
    y = "count (HUD areas)",
    caption = "Figure 3"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
ggplot(state_areas, aes(fmr, stusps)) +

  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "fmr ($)", y = "stusps", colour = "metro", caption = "Figure 4") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
# pseudo-log axis: linear near zero so zero-population records stay visible
ggplot(filter(fmr, bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS), aes(pop2024)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(record_type), labeller = label_both) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    transform = scales::transform_pseudo_log(),
    breaks = c(0, 10^(1:7)),
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-8
#| fig-width: 7.1
#| fig-height: 4.2
weighted_ecdf <- function(fmr, weight, unit) {
  o <- order(fmr)
  weight <- rep_len(weight, length(fmr))
  tibble(
    bedrooms = REF_BEDROOMS,
    fmr = fmr[o],
    cumulative = cumsum(weight[o]) / sum(weight),
    unit = unit
  )
}

ecdf_units <- bind_rows(
  weighted_ecdf(records_ref$fmr, 1, "record"),
  weighted_ecdf(areas_ref$fmr, 1, "HUD area"),
  weighted_ecdf(records_ref$fmr, records_ref$pop2024, "population")
)

ggplot(ecdf_units, aes(fmr, cumulative, colour = unit)) +
  geom_step() +
  facet_wrap(vars(bedrooms), labeller = label_both) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = "fmr ($)", y = "cumulative proportion", colour = "unit",
    caption = "Figure 8"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-9
#| fig-width: 7.1
#| fig-height: 5.5
ranked_areas <- areas |>
  filter(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS) |>
  arrange(fmr, hud_area_name)

extreme_codes <- c(
  head(ranked_areas$hud_area_code, N_EXTREME),
  tail(ranked_areas$hud_area_code, N_EXTREME)
)

extreme_areas <- areas |>
  filter(hud_area_code %in% extreme_codes) |>
  mutate(
    hud_area_name = str_remove(hud_area_name, " HUD Metro FMR Area"),
    hud_area_name = fct_reorder(
      hud_area_name, if_else(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS, fmr, NA_real_),
      .fun = max, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    bedrooms = factor(bedrooms)
  )

ggplot(extreme_areas, aes(fmr, hud_area_name, colour = bedrooms)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = "fmr ($)", y = "hud_area_name", colour = "bedrooms",
    caption = "Figure 9"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

# Supporting exploration and data checks

Figures 1--9 above are the final graphs. The tables below document the
exploration and data checks behind them, using `fmr2027.csv`. Each check
states its unit of analysis: *record* (one geographic record), *area* (one
HUD FMR area), or *population-weighted*.

## Dataset structure

```{r}
#| label: structure
cat(
  "rows:", nrow(fmr_raw), " columns:", ncol(fmr_raw),
  "\ngeographic records (distinct fips):", n_distinct(fmr_raw$fips),
  "\nHUD FMR areas (distinct hud_area_code):",
  n_distinct(fmr_raw$hud_area_code),
  "\nbedroom values:", paste(bedroom_levels, collapse = ", "), "\n"
)

fmr_raw |>
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    list(
      type = \(x) class(x)[1],
      unique = n_distinct,
      missing = \(x) sum(is.na(x)),
      min = \(x) if (is.numeric(x)) min(x, na.rm = TRUE) else NA,
      max = \(x) if (is.numeric(x)) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) else NA
    ),
    .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
  )) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(), names_to = c("column", ".value"), names_sep = "__"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    pct_missing = round(100 * missing / nrow(fmr_raw), 2),
    .after = missing
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Duplicates, keys, and completeness

```{r}
#| label: duplicates
tibble(
  check = c(
    "fully duplicated rows",
    "duplicated (fips, bedrooms) keys",
    "fips values that do not have every bedroom count",
    "fips with more than one countyname, pop2024, metro, or area",
    "fips whose first two digits differ from state",
    "state codes that map to more than one stusps"
  ),
  count = c(
    sum(duplicated(fmr_raw)),
    sum(duplicated(fmr_raw[c("fips", "bedrooms")])),
    sum(count(fmr_raw, fips)$n != length(bedroom_levels)),
    fmr_raw |>
      summarise(
        bad = n_distinct(countyname) > 1 | n_distinct(pop2024) > 1 |
          n_distinct(metro) > 1 | n_distinct(hud_area_code) > 1,
        .by = fips
      ) |>
      pull(bad) |>
      sum(),
    sum(str_sub(fmr_raw$fips, 1, 2) != fmr_raw$state),
    sum(count(distinct(fmr_raw, state, stusps), state)$n > 1)
  )
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Missing town names and record types

```{r}
#| label: record-types
fmr |>
  filter(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS) |>
  summarise(
    records = n(),
    missing_town_name = sum(is.na(county_town_name)),
    .by = record_type
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()

fmr |>
  filter(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS, record_type == "sub-county") |>
  count(stusps, name = "sub_county_records") |>
  knitr::kable()

# county-level records that nevertheless carry a name
fmr |>
  filter(
    bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS, record_type == "county",
    !is.na(county_town_name)
  ) |>
  select(fips, stusps, countyname, county_town_name, pop2024) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Repeated HUD areas and rent schedules

```{r}
#| label: repeated-areas
multi_state_areas <- fmr |>
  filter(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS) |>
  summarise(n_states = n_distinct(stusps), .by = hud_area_code) |>
  filter(n_states > 1)

areas_ref |>
  summarise(
    areas = n(),
    areas_with_1_record = sum(n_records == 1),
    areas_with_2plus_records = sum(n_records > 1),
    records_in_shared_areas = sum(n_records[n_records > 1]),
    max_records_in_one_area = max(n_records),
    areas_spanning_states = nrow(multi_state_areas)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  knitr::kable()

areas_ref |>
  arrange(desc(n_records)) |>
  select(hud_area_name, n_records, pop, fmr) |>
  head(5) |>
  knitr::kable()

# different areas can also share an identical set of rents
areas |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = hud_area_code, names_from = bedrooms, values_from = fmr,
    names_prefix = "bed"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    areas = n(),
    distinct_schedules = nrow(distinct(pick(starts_with("bed"))))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: metro-coding
fmr |>

  mutate(area_prefix = str_extract(hud_area_code, "^[A-Z]+")) |>
  count(metro, area_prefix, name = "records") |>
  knitr::kable()

areas_ref |>
```

## Population values

```{r}
#| label: population
fmr |>
  filter(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS) |>
  summarise(
    records = n(),
    zero_pop = sum(pop2024 == 0),
    below_100 = sum(pop2024 > 0 & pop2024 < 100),
    median_pop = median(pop2024),
    max_pop = max(pop2024),
    .by = record_type
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()

fmr |>
  filter(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS, pop2024 == 0) |>
  count(stusps, metro, name = "zero_pop_records") |>
  knitr::kable()

fmr |>
  filter(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS, pop2024 == 0) |>
  select(stusps, countyname, county_town_name) |>
  head(8) |>
  knitr::kable()

cat("areas with zero total population:", sum(areas_ref$pop == 0), "\n")
```

## Distribution of fmr and bedroom structure

```{r}
#| label: fmr-distribution
quartile_summary <- function(data, label) {
  data |>
    summarise(
      n = n(), min = min(fmr),
      q1 = quantile(fmr, 0.25), median = median(fmr),
      q3 = quantile(fmr, 0.75), max = max(fmr), mean = mean(fmr),
      # Bowley skewness: > 0 means a longer upper half of the box
      bowley = ((q3 - median) - (median - q1)) / (q3 - q1),
      .by = bedrooms
    ) |>
    mutate(unit = label, .before = 1) |>
    arrange(bedrooms)
}

bind_rows(
  quartile_summary(fmr, "record"),
  quartile_summary(areas, "area")
) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  knitr::kable()

# exactly repeated two-bedroom values across HUD areas
areas_ref |>
  summarise(
    areas = n(),
    states = n_distinct(area_states$stusps[
      area_states$hud_area_code %in% hud_area_code
    ]),
    nonmetro_areas = sum(metro == "nonmetro"),
    .by = fmr
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(areas)) |>
  mutate(share_of_areas = round(areas / nrow(areas_ref), 3)) |>
  head(5) |>
  knitr::kable()

# monotonicity within each geographic record
fmr |>
  arrange(fips, bedrooms) |>
  summarise(
    non_decreasing = all(diff(fmr) >= 0),
    strictly_increasing = all(diff(fmr) > 0),
    .by = fips
  ) |>
  summarise(
    records = n(),
    non_decreasing = sum(non_decreasing),
    strictly_increasing = sum(strictly_increasing)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()

bedroom_ratios |>
  summarise(
    min = min(ratio), median = median(ratio), max = max(ratio),
    areas_at_min_ratio = sum(ratio < min(ratio) + 0.005),
    areas_at_max_ratio = sum(ratio > max(ratio) - 0.005),
    n_areas = n(),
    .by = bedrooms
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Geographic comparisons: the unit of analysis matters

```{r}
#| label: geography
weighted_median <- function(x, w) {
  if (sum(w) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  o <- order(x)
  x[o][which(cumsum(w[o]) >= sum(w) / 2)[1]]
}

state_summary <- full_join(
  fmr |>
    filter(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS) |>
    summarise(
      records = n(),
      median_record = median(fmr),
      median_pop_weighted = weighted_median(fmr, pop2024),
      .by = stusps
    ),
  state_areas |>
    summarise(areas = n(), median_area = median(fmr), .by = stusps),
  by = "stusps"
)

state_summary |>
  mutate(gap = abs(median_record - median_area)) |>
  arrange(desc(gap)) |>
  head(10) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x))) |>
  knitr::kable()

# share of between-area variation in log(fmr) associated with state
cat(
  "R-squared, log(fmr) ~ state (one row per area-state pair):",
  round(summary(lm(log(fmr) ~ stusps, data = state_areas))$r.squared, 3), "\n"
)

areas_ref |>
  summarise(
    areas = n(),
    q1 = quantile(fmr, 0.25), median = median(fmr), q3 = quantile(fmr, 0.75),
    .by = metro
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Population and fmr

```{r}
#| label: population-vs-fmr
# Spearman: rank-based, so it is not distorted by the skewed population scale
bind_rows(
  fmr |>
    filter(bedrooms == REF_BEDROOMS) |>
    summarise(
      unit = "record", n = n(),
      rho = cor(pop2024, fmr, method = "spearman"),
      .by = record_type
    ) |>
    rename(group = record_type),
  areas_ref |>
    summarise(
      unit = "area", n = n(),
      rho = cor(pop, fmr, method = "spearman"),
      .by = metro
    ) |>
    mutate(group = as.character(metro), .keep = "unused")
) |>
  mutate(rho = round(rho, 3)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
